notes: 'Whose Tools?' introduces children to common construction and trade tools. The existing activity_images vocab covers most key tools (hammer, saw, wrench, drill, ladder, tape_measure, pliers, hard_hat) and aac_extras cover build, fix, worker, job — all reusable here. 'tool' (generic) is added as a unifying concept word. 'pliers' and 'job' from existing assets were deprioritised in favour of 'tool' and 'ladder' for broader communicative utility on the board, but could substitute if preferred. The hero is a generic construction worker so no custom sourcing is needed.
